title: Test-kit --list Totals count declared skips, contradicting the badge
cluster_summary: Root cause: LibKa0s testkit/framework.lua renderTotals (line 569, Kit.VERSION 37, HEAD 353f286) prints #tests, the whole registry, including declared skips. Its renderInventory preamble (:576-577) calls that number the authoritative pass count the badge must match, which contradicts testing-§5 and the kit's own docblock at :204. So every consumer with a declared skip ships an inventory Total one above its correct badge (verified: KickCD 1303 vs 1302, PanelMaster 1036 vs 1035, and others). The single fix lives in LibKa0s: Total counts non-skipped cases, a Skipped row is added when any exist, the header is reworded, a kit self-test is added, Kit.VERSION goes 37->38 and it ships in this remediation's LibKa0s minor release. Each addon then clears its finding with the whole-tree tests/_kit re-vendor it gets anyway, regenerating docs/test-cases.md in the same commit. No local edits. Severity is low: only a generated doc row is wrong, and badges and gates are correct.

verdicts.assessment: Confirmed at LibKa0s testkit/framework.lua:569 (#tests) and :576-577 (header). It breaks the testing-§5 MUST and the kit's own docblock, and will recur in every audit. Severity drops medium->low because only a generated doc row is wrong. This finding carries the whole cluster.
verdicts.remediation: In LibKa0s testkit/framework.lua: renderTotals sets Total to the count of registered non-skipped cases (t.skip excluded) and adds a '| Skipped | N |' row when N>0; reword the renderInventory header (:576-577) so the badge must equal the passing Total; add a kit self-test covering a declared skip; bump Kit.VERSION 37->38; ship in this remediation's LibKa0s minor release. Then in AuraMaster, re-vendor tests/_kit/ whole and regenerate docs/test-cases.md in the same commit (Total 2049 = badge). No local edit to tests/_kit/.

verdicts.assessment: The defect is real (verified Total 1303 at docs/test-cases.md:1620 vs badge 1302/1302). The claim that the skip is decided at run time is wrong. The proposed host-specific registration and '(1 skips here)' wording are rejected in favour of the Skipped-row fix.
